items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Austin Powell, we had the band together.

ctx.x: Well, it was off and on. When I didn't have a steady job I'd do that, you

see. But I would always be on the union floor on Wednesday. Yes. (laughter) Oh boy, oh boy. And then, let's see, I think I'm leaving out another job. Oh, I did a lot of jobs in Brooklyn. I worked the Town Hill. I did that in 1960. Austin Powell, we had the band together. And that was seven days a week, three shows a night, whether it rained or snowed or the sun was shinin'. That was after I left the Elegante. Then I did some other jobs. I did another job jor about 30 weeks...I can't think of the name of this…
